note: The Bank of Albania's page on the borrower's report: data reported to the Credit Registry stays up to five years after the loan is repaid or written off. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Bank of Albania, Credit Registry: Borrower's Report
sources.said: The data reported to the Credit Registry stay up to five years after the loan repayment or its write off from the balance sheet of the bank granting the loan.
